result.title: X-3DComposer: Feed-Forward 3D Scene Composition with Any Assets from Any Views
result.summary: Composing an editable 3D scene from images requires an asset for each object and a layout that places the assets. 3D generation and CAD retrieval now supply the assets, but layout still lacks a general solution: scene generation methods couple it with generation, and pose estimators handle one object at a time and need true-size CAD models, depth, or iterative refinement. We present X-3DComposer, a feed-forward model that predicts the layout separately from asset generation. Given one or more images of a scene, the object masks, and an asset for each object from any source, it jointly predicts the rotation, translation, and per-axis scale of all objects in a single forward pass of about one second. The key idea is to treat objects as views: renders of the assets are processed together with the scene images by a multi-view geometry model adapted from VGGT-$Ω$, and each object pose follows in closed form from the cameras predicted for its renders. Camera intrinsics, camera poses, and depth are optional inputs. When the meshes produced by five scene generation methods are kept fixed and only their layout is replaced, the layouts of X-3DComposer are more accurate than the native layouts of these methods. Compared with the stand-alone layout model SceneMaker, it reduces the scene-level Chamfer distance by 52% on IndoorMix, our test set from six indoor datasets, and by 28% on 3D-FUTURE.

AI.relevance_reason: 该文是前馈式 3D 场景布局预测（把物体渲染当作视角、由多视图几何模型预测相机并闭式解出位姿与尺度），目标是可编辑 3D 资产生成而非 VLM 推理；虽涉及几何信息，但不讨论内部推理状态、证据筛选、停止决策或 latent 训练监督，缺少可供核查的 LVR 联系。
